resume: A mandatory, free procedure at the town hall of the place of birth, within 5 days after delivery. The documents to bring, and the family record book (livret de famille) given to you on this occasion.
aQuoiCaSert: Registering the birth creates the child's birth certificate (acte de naissance): without it, the child has no civil status. For a first child, the town hall (mairie) also issues the family record book (livret de famille), free of charge. It is the starting point for rights with the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) and the Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance). After the deadline, the town hall can no longer register the birth on its own: a court decision is needed.
quiEstConcerne: The father, the second mother, or anyone who attended the birth (doctor, midwife, head of the facility).
If the mother gives birth alone in hospital, the facility registers the birth.
aSavoir: Deadline: 5 days after delivery, not counting the day of delivery. If the last day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it is moved to the next working day.
In Réunion, this 5-day deadline applies in every town: the official page provides no exception for the island.
The birth is registered at the town hall of the place of birth, which is not necessarily the one where you live (for example the town where the maternity unit is located).
After the deadline, a court declaration before the tribunal judiciaire (judicial court) is required.
Unmarried parents: the father must recognize the child (reconnaissance) for paternal parentage to be established. He can do so before the birth or when registering it.
Family record book: for a first child, it is issued free of charge by the town hall of the place of birth, on presentation of an ID document.

documents.detail: Free. Request them after registration, at the town hall or online.

etapes.titre: Get the delivery certificate from the maternity unit
etapes.detail: Also ask whether the maternity unit arranges for the registration to be sent to the town hall.
Delivery certificate, both parents' ID documents, prenatal recognition if there is one, signed surname declaration if you make one, existing family record book. Work out the deadline: 5 days.

etapes.titre: Go to the town hall of the place of birth within the deadline
etapes.detail: Civil registry office (état civil). An unmarried father who has not yet recognized the child can do so at the same time.

etapes.titre: Collect the birth certificate and the family record book
etapes.detail: Ask for several copies of the certificate: the Caf, the Assurance Maladie and the mutuelle (top-up health insurance) ask for them.

etapes.titre: Report the birth to the Caf and the Assurance Maladie
etapes.detail: In your Caf account, and in your ameli account to add the child.
